newsitem.title: UK: European jet fuel tumbles with gas oil.
newsitem.headline: European jet fuel tumbles with gas oil.

text.p: European jet fuel lost up to $4 a tonne on Tuesday after sharp falls on Monday.
Traders said the drop was the result of weaker IPE gas oil futures which were trading $4 a tonne lower at 1545 GMT.
Physical demand for jet fuel remains sparse and supplies are not very well offered, traders said.
Barges in NWE were holding on to premiums of around March IPE +$20 fob ARA with cargo premiums about +$23 cif.
In the Mediterranean, some support was derived from the Tunisian tender for 18-20,000 tonnes which closes later on Tuesday.
"A few people are putting their feelers out," said a trader.
Supplies are not overly plentiful for the April 2-5 delivery tender and there was market talk the Libyan fuel currently available may be used to meet the Tunisian requirement.
EC jet was pegged around March IPE +$8-9 fob, with non EC assessed $3-4 below this level.
